metadata.cache_condition: WARM OS page cache. No cold-cache measurement is made or claimed.

churn.overwrites: records // 5 puts of uniformly drawn keys (with replacement); every 20th has an empty value
churn.deletes: records // 20 distinct keys, drawn without replacement
churn.resurrections: a tenth of each round's deletes are written again with a new value
churn.order: 10 rounds, each: a tenth of the overwrites, a tenth of the deletes, then that round's resurrections

metadata.timing_notes: Only store.get calls are timed (one perf_counter_ns pair per GET, as V0..V5); percentiles are nearest-rank (same code). compact() is timed twice: by the store (duration_s, inside the call) and around the call (wall_s). The cache outcome of each GET and its result checksum are recorded outside the timed interval. The read-work samples, the table-heap measurement, the full scans, the correctness checks and the memory/I-O probes are untimed and run between or after the timed phases. open_recovery is the first KVStore(path) after close() in the same process (before) and the reopen after the compacted store was closed (after), both with an empty cache.
